result.summary: VERIFY_ONLY definition of canonical serialization, stable entity-hash, and offline Private Reality journal invariants for G4-001. No product writes. Persist (P1) is sole product writer. Scope is local/offline Private Reality simulation only — NOT Shared District, server economy, multiplayer ownership, or online durable authority.

in_scope: Canonical journal envelope + ordered append-only entries
Stable entity serialization + SHA-256 entity/world content hashes
Idempotency by request_id, revision optimistic concurrency, compensation as new append
G3 expected_world_revision=3 preservation through save/reload evidence contract
API surface recommendation for game/scripts/modules/persist and i_persist_module.gd
out_of_scope: Product implementation under game/scripts/modules/persist/** (P1 sole writer)
contracts/* edits (not required for G4 local journal; journal is module-local schema documented here)
Server World Commit live service, economy, inventory, marketplace ownership
Transactional outbox bus publish (documentary only; optional later)

authority_boundary.durable_state: local signed journal only; reconcile on sync uses mutation_class offline_reconcile / authority.source offline_journal_reconcile when server path exists later
explicit_not: claim that local journal IS online World Commit truth
authority_boundary.architecture_lock: orchestration/ARCHITECTURE_LOCK.md Offline Private Reality row: Local signed journal; reconcile on sync

g3_revision_binding_preserved.invariant_for_g4: Any G4 save/reload smoke that consumes G3 complete-path fixtures MUST preserve expected_world_revision=3 (and resulting world_revision progression from base 3) in journal head and reloaded state. Builder default 0 must never win after a snapshot with revision 3 is loaded.

cancel_and_undo_do_not_advance_revision_.g3_undo: compensating stub only in G3; G4 may apply real compensation append that advances local world_revision when mutation_applied succeeds

journal_envelope.name: private_reality_journal
journal_envelope.storage_shape: single JSON document (MVP) OR NDJSON with header line + one entry per line; both must round-trip to identical entity hashes. Recommended MVP: single object with ordered entries[] for simpler Godot FileAccess.

schema_version.description: Journal format version. Incompatible major/minor refuse load fail-closed.

space_type.description: G4 journal is Private Reality only. shared_district and other space_types are forbidden in this journal file.

world_revision.description: Head revision after applying all valid entries in order. Must equal base_world_revision + count(successful mutation_applied and compensation entries that advanced revision). Seed from live snapshot (G3 starter = 3).

entries.description: STRICTLY ordered append-only log. Index 0 is oldest. Never reorder, delete, or rewrite prior elements.

recommended_fields.base_world_revision: integer — revision of empty or snapshot seed before first entry (G3 starter seed = 3)
recommended_fields.entity_set_hash: sha256 hex of full canonical entity set at head (see entity_hash)

integrity.description: Optional chain hash: H0 = sha256(canonical_json(header_without_integrity)); Hi = sha256(Hi-1 || canonical_json(entry_i)). Stored as head_chain_hash. Signing is local integrity only, not multiplayer authority.

ordering_rules: entries are totally ordered by append sequence (array index).
world_revision is monotonically non-decreasing; it increases by exactly 1 on each successful mutation_applied or compensation that mutates entities.

idempotent_replay and rejected/conflicted outcomes MUST NOT be stored as mutation_applied; if recorded for audit, use a non-mutating entry type only if P1 implements audit_event — default MVP stores only applied mutations and compensations.
Never delete or rewrite prior entries; compensation is a NEW entry.

mutation_applied.purpose: Record a successful local Private Reality durable mutation (confirmed prompt applied to local journal). This is the only path that creates/updates durable local entities from a create/modify/delete/enrich flow.

required_fields.request_id: uuid — IDEMPOTENCY KEY (same as commit_request.request_id / world_prompt.request_id)
required_fields.receipt_id: uuid — local receipt for this apply
required_fields.expected_world_revision: integer — must equal journal head world_revision BEFORE apply
required_fields.entity_ids: array of string entity ids touched (sorted for hash material)
required_fields.operation: create | modify | delete | enrich | gift_proposal (from world_prompt)
required_fields.entity_delta: canonical entity records after mutation for touched ids (or full tombstone for delete)

idempotency.rule: If request_id already appears in any mutation_applied or compensation entry, do NOT re-apply. Return status idempotent_replay with prior_receipt_id of the first successful entry. No new entity, no revision bump, no second entry required (optional audit_event only).

revision_check.rule: If expected_world_revision != current journal.world_revision, reject with conflict code revision_mismatch; write NOTHING (no partial entity mutation, no append).

compensation.purpose: Append-only inverse of a prior successful mutation. Undo/history correction. NEVER deletes or rewrites the prior entry.

required_fields.request_id: uuid — NEW idempotency key (must not equal prior request_id)
required_fields.prior_receipt_id: uuid — REQUIRED link to the mutation_applied (or prior compensation chain head) being compensated
required_fields.expected_world_revision: integer — must equal head before apply

rules: Compensation is always a new append; prior_receipt_id remains readable forever.
history_erased must be false; history_preserved semantics from G3 undo are mandatory.
Compensating a missing prior_receipt_id fails closed (no append).
Duplicate compensation request_id follows same idempotent_replay rule as mutation_applied.
Aligns with commit_request.mutation_class compensating and blueprint 05: Undo creates a compensating mutation; history is not erased.

explicitly_never_entry_types_for_durable.cancel: Cancelled previews NEVER enter the durable journal. Cancel tears down wireframe/hologram/materializing preview only (G3 g3_cancel_receipt: durable_mutation_applied=false, has_durable_collision=false).
explicitly_never_entry_types_for_durable.preview_stages: wireframe | hologram | materializing | complete-as-preview-only without confirmed apply do not journal.
explicitly_never_entry_types_for_durable.agm_soft_effects: dialogue, mood, quest text alone are not journal mutations unless a separate WO defines session soft-state (out of G4 durable entity journal).
explicitly_never_entry_types_for_durable.commit_handoff_stub_rejected: G3 complete path with world_commit_invoked=false and durable_mutation_applied=false is NOT automatically a mutation_applied entry. P1 may promote a confirmed local apply for Private Reality simulation only when explicitly applying through persist apply_mutation; stubs alone are not journaled as durable.

append_only_invariants: No entry is deleted, truncated, or rewritten in place.
Corrections and undos = compensation entries only.
ARCHITECTURE_LOCK persistence: append-only mutation log + snapshots (snapshots optional checkpoint later; not required for MVP hash equality if full replay is deterministic).

canonical_serialization.name: aidle_canonical_json_v1
canonical_serialization.purpose: Deterministic UTF-8 JSON for hashing and durable entity material. Same logical state => identical bytes => identical SHA-256.

rules.rule: Object keys are sorted lexicographically by Unicode code point (UTF-8 byte order). Nested objects recurse the same rule.
When serializing an entity SET (world entity map), emit an array of entity records sorted by entity_id ascending (lexicographic). Do not rely on Dictionary insertion order.

Semantic arrays that are ordered by product meaning (e.g. manifestation stages const, geometry build_order) keep declared order. Non-semantic sets (entity_ids, interaction_tags for hash material) MUST be sorted ascending and unique.
Hash material uses compact JSON: no insignificant whitespace, no pretty indentation. (Human-readable exports under persist/exports may pretty-print separately; hash MUST use compact canonical form.)
Only JSON null, bool, number, string, array, object. No NaN/Infinity. No Godot-specific types in durable material.

Whole numbers that are schema integers (world_revision, entry_count, max_entities) serialize as integers without decimal point. Floating fields (transform.x/y/elevation/rotation_deg, bounds, surrealism_budget) use a fixed decimal format to prevent floats-as-string drift.

Floats: trim to a fixed maximum of 6 fractional digits, then strip trailing zeros and trailing decimal point if empty fractional part. Examples: 8.0 -> "8"; 8.500000 -> "8.5"; 0.12 -> "0.12". Reject non-finite. Do NOT use language-default free-format that differs across platforms. Implementation: pure GDScript formatter, not str(float) alone.
rules.guidance: Prefer storing grid-aligned coordinates as integers where product allows (tile x/y). When numbers must be float, always pass through the same formatter before stringify.

rules.rule: JSON string escaping per RFC 8259. No trailing spaces. UUIDs lowercase hex with hyphens as already used in fixtures.

Exclude non-state noise: occurred_at of journal meta (optional separate audit hash), updated_at, integrity chain fields, runtime node paths, preview mesh instance ids, RNG seeds that are not part of entity record, API credentials (forbidden entirely).

Canonical durable entity record (minimum): entity_id, kind, recipe_id, transform{x,y,elevation,rotation_deg}, bounds{width,depth,height}, interaction_tags (sorted), space_id, chunk_id?, status (active|tombstoned), origin_request_id, origin_prompt_id. additionalProperties forbidden in hash material — unknown keys dropped or fail validation before hash.

Deleted entities remain as tombstones in the entity set for revision history reconstruction OR are omitted from active set but recorded in entry entity_delta; choose ONE approach in P1 and keep it for hash. Recommended: active entity set excludes tombstones; entity_set_hash hashes only active entities; compensation can restore.

canonical_serialization.godot_note: Godot 4 JSON.stringify does NOT sort keys. Persist MUST implement canonical_stringify(value) in pure GDScript (recursive sort + float format). Do not hash JSON.stringify(dict) output directly.

entity_hash.input: UTF-8 bytes of aidle_canonical_json_v1(entity_record) for single-entity hash; UTF-8 bytes of aidle_canonical_json_v1(sorted_entity_array) for entity_set_hash

steps: var ctx := HashingContext.new()
ctx.start(HashingContext.HASH_SHA256)
ctx.update(canonical_utf8_packed_byte_array)
var digest: PackedByteArray = ctx.finish()
hex encode each byte as two lowercase hex digits

outputs.entity_set_hash: sha256(canonical(array of active entity_records sorted by entity_id))

entity_hash.stability_guarantee: Save then reload (replay journal from base + entries, rebuild entity set, re-hash) MUST yield identical entity_hash per entity_id and identical entity_set_hash. This is the primary G4 acceptance signal.

fail_closed_cases.behavior: Return conflicted / revision_mismatch with expected and actual; no entity mutation; no journal append; no partial writes.

fail_closed_cases.trigger: apply with request_id already present in a successful mutation_applied or compensation entry
fail_closed_cases.behavior: Return idempotent_replay with prior_receipt_id; do not create duplicate entity; do not bump world_revision; do not append a second mutation entry.

fail_closed_cases.trigger: JSON parse failure, missing required envelope fields, entries not array, entry missing required fields, entry_count mismatch, broken chain hash if enabled
fail_closed_cases.behavior: Refuse load. Expose clear recovery error (e.g. journal_malformed | journal_truncated). Do NOT silently invent empty world or skip bad entries to 'best effort'.
fail_closed_cases.recovery: Surface error to player/UI; optional restore from last known good snapshot file if P1 implements snapshots — still fail closed if none.

fail_closed_cases.behavior: Refuse load with error journal_schema_incompatible. No automatic migration in G4-001 unless explicitly implemented and tested; default is fail closed.
Refuse load/apply. G4 journal is not Shared District authority.
Reject; no append; no entity change.

fail_closed_cases.trigger: attempt to journal cancel / unconfirmed preview as mutation_applied
fail_closed_cases.behavior: Reject. Cancelled previews NEVER enter durable journal.

P1 SHOULD write via temp file + atomic replace (or fsync pattern) so reload either sees old complete journal or new complete journal — never half-entry. If half-entry detected on load => truncated/malformed fail closed.

cancelled_previews_never_durable.rule: Cancelled previews NEVER enter durable journal.

evidence_from_g3.note: Cancel removes preview only; not a compensating mutation

cancelled_previews_never_durable.persist_gate: apply_mutation requires confirmation.state==confirmed (or explicit local Private Reality apply path after confirm) AND must not accept receipt_kind==cancel. Manifestation stages before durable apply are ephemeral.

invariants.statement: Journal space_type is always private_reality; G4 does not claim Shared District / multiplayer / server economy authority.
Journal entries are append-only; never delete or rewrite history; compensation links prior_receipt_id.
request_id is the idempotency key; duplicate never creates a second entity or second revision bump.
expected_world_revision must match head world_revision or apply fails closed with revision_mismatch and zero partial mutation.
entity_hash and entity_set_hash are SHA-256 over aidle_canonical_json_v1 UTF-8; save/reload equality is mandatory.
Canonical JSON uses sorted object keys and stable entity_id order; floats use fixed decimal rules to avoid string drift.
Cancelled previews and unconfirmed manifestation never produce mutation_applied journal entries.
Compensation is a new entry with mutation_class=compensating, new request_id, and prior_receipt_id; history_erased=false.
G3 starter seed world_revision/expected_world_revision=3 is preserved through save/reload evidence; default 0 must not overwrite loaded snapshot revision.
Truncated, malformed, or incompatible-schema journals refuse load with explicit error; never invent state.

Local journal apply is Offline Private Reality simulation durability only; online durable mutations still require World Commit service (authority.commit_path=world_commit_service). Local journal may later reconcile via offline_journal_reconcile — not implemented as multiplayer truth in G4.
No API keys, tokens, or credentials in journal, saves, or hash material (ARCHITECTURE_LOCK forbidden paths).

recommended_interface_methods.name: create_journal
recommended_interface_methods.args: space_id: String, base_world_revision: int, base_snapshot_id: String, session_id: String
recommended_interface_methods.notes: space_type forced private_reality; base_world_revision for G3 seed is 3

recommended_interface_methods.returns: Dictionary { ok, journal?, world_revision?, entity_set_hash?, error_code?, error? }

recommended_interface_methods.name: apply_mutation
recommended_interface_methods.args: request: Dictionary (request_id, expected_world_revision, operation, entity payload, mutation_class durable_world|offline_reconcile, ...)
recommended_interface_methods.returns: Dictionary { status: committed|idempotent_replay|conflicted|rejected, receipt_id?, prior_receipt_id?, old_world_revision?, new_world_revision?, entity_ids?, entity_set_hash?, conflict?, rejection? }
recommended_interface_methods.notes: Idempotent on request_id; revision check; appends mutation_applied only on success

recommended_interface_methods.name: apply_compensation
recommended_interface_methods.args: request: Dictionary (request_id NEW, prior_receipt_id, prior_request_id, expected_world_revision, compensated_entity_ids, ...)
recommended_interface_methods.notes: Appends compensation entry; never erases prior

recommended_interface_methods.returns: String hex sha256 or empty if missing

recommended_interface_methods.name: entity_set_hash
recommended_interface_methods.returns: String hex sha256 of full active set

recommended_interface_methods.name: canonical_stringify
recommended_interface_methods.notes: Pure GDScript; used by hash functions and tests

apply_mutation creating cozy_house_small-like entity with expected_world_revision=3
record entity_hash(es) and entity_set_hash and world_revision
save_journal to temp path
load_journal / replay_to_entities in fresh module instance
assert identical entity_hash per id, identical entity_set_hash, identical world_revision

apply_mutation again with same request_id R and same or different payload

save and reload
